description: B22: a recharge turn keeps the FractionalPriority of the recharging Pokemon. Setup turn: Clefable's Gravity (faster) then Sableye's (Stall) Hyper Beam on Snorlax, which cannot miss under Gravity, so Sableye must recharge. The turn: Sableye (Stall, -0.1) recharges after the slower Snorlax's Payback, which therefore sees a target that has not moved (50 base power); an engine that gives the recharge priority 0 lets Sableye act first and doubles Payback.
